content: Analizando el contexto del proyecto presentado por el usuario
Estoy organizando una visión clara y coherente del ecosistema educativo digital diseñado para personas mayores de 40 años sin experiencia previa en tecnología.
Explorando profundamente las fuentes disponibles para validar la autenticidad y contenido del proyecto

Estoy examinando las señales emergentes de un esfuerzo colectivo centrado en la educación y el empoderamiento social, con especial atención a comunidades latinoamericanas y migrantes.  
Detecto una intención clara de promover inclusión, acceso al conocimiento y autonomía mediante herramientas digitales adaptadas a contextos diversos.  
Mi enfoque se orienta hacia comprender profundamente sus valores, objetivos y el impacto humano que busca generar.

Me enfoco en integrar recursos diversos, desde formación básica hasta programas especializados, asegurando accesibilidad y veracidad de la información.  
Destaco el rol central de "Manos Abiertas" como plataforma unificadora que conecta a la comunidad inmigrante con herramientas digitales inclusivas y relevantes.  
Mi objetivo es facilitar el empoderamiento tecnológico mediante contenidos estructurados, confiables y adaptados a las necesidades reales de quienes buscan superar barreras digitales.

Estoy analizando cada elemento mencionado, desde los datos numéricos hasta los contactos y marcas registradas, buscando coincidencias con registros oficiales o plataformas reconocidas  
Evalúo la coherencia entre el propósito declarado —ayudar a comunidades latinoamericanas y migrantes en España— y los recursos descritos, verificando si existen evidencias públicas de su existencia real  
Con base en esta revisión crítica, estoy construyendo una respuesta fundamentada que distingue entre lo afirmado y lo comprobable

import { azureManagedIdentityTokenProvider } from 'openai/auth'; const client = new OpenAI({ workloadIdentity: { identityProviderId: 'idp-123', serviceAccountId: 'sa-456', provider: azureManagedIdentityTokenProvider(), }, }); const client = new OpenAI({ workloadIdentity: { identityProviderId: 'idp-123', serviceAccountId: 'sa-456', provider: k8sServiceAccountTokenProvider('/var/token'), refreshBufferSeconds: 120.0, }, }); ``` ## Streaming responses Permalink: Streaming responses We provide support for streaming responses using Server-Sent Events (SSE). ``` import OpenAI from 'openai'; const client = new OpenAI(); const stream = await client.responses.create({ model: 'gpt-5.5', input: 'Say "Sheep sleep deep" ten times fast!', stream: true, }); for await (const event of stream) { console.log(event); } ``` ## File uploads Permalink: File uploads Request parameters that correspond to file uploads can be passed in many different forms: - `File` (or an object with the same structure) - a `fetch``Response` (or an object with the same structure) - an `fs.ReadStream` - the return value of our `toFile` or `toStreamingFile` helpers ``` import fs from 'fs'; import OpenAI, { toFile, toStreamingFile } from 'openai'; const client = new OpenAI(); // If you have access to Node `fs` we recommend using `fs.createReadStream()`: await client.files.create({ file: fs.createReadStream('input.jsonl'), purpose: 'fine-tune' }); // Or if you have the web `File` API you can pass a `File` instance: await client.files.create({ file: new File(['my bytes'], 'input.jsonl'), purpose: 'fine-tune' }); // You can also pass a `fetch` `Response`: await client.files.create({ file: await fetch('https://somesite/input.jsonl'), purpose: 'fine-tune', }); // Finally, if none of the above are convenient, you can use our `toFile` helper: await client.files.create({ file: await toFile(Buffer.from('my bytes'), 'input.jsonl'), purpose: 'fine-tune', }); await client.files.create({ file: await toFile(new Uint8Array([0, 1, 2]), 'input.jsonl'), purpose: 'fine-tune', }); // `toFile()` creates a web File, so it must buffer stream inputs before sending them. // Use `toStreamingFile()` to stream an arbitrary web, Node, or cloud-storage stream directly: await client.files.create({ file: toStreamingFile(myReadableStream, 'input.jsonl', { type: 'application/jsonl' }), purpose: 'fine-tune', }); ``` ## Webhook Verification Permalink: Webhook Verification Verifying webhook signatures is _optional but encouraged_. For more information about webhooks, see the API docs. ### Parsing webhook payloads Permalink: Parsing webhook payloads For most use cases, you will likely want to verify the webhook and parse the payload at the same time. To achieve this, we provide the method `client.webhooks.unwrap()`, which parses a webhook request and verifies that it was sent by OpenAI. This method will throw an error if the signature is invalid. Note that the `body` parameter must be the raw JSON string sent from the server (do not parse it first). The `.unwrap()` method will parse this JSON for you into an event object after verifying the webhook was sent from OpenAI. ``` import { headers } from 'next/headers'; import OpenAI from 'openai'; const client = new OpenAI({ webhookSecret: process.env.OPENAI_WEBHOOK_SECRET, // env var used by default; explicit here. }); export async function webhook(request: Request) { const headersList = headers(); const body = await request.text(); try { const event = client.webhooks.unwrap(body, headersList); switch (event.type) { case 'response.completed': console.log('Response completed:', event.data); break; case 'response.failed': console.log('Response failed:', event.data); break; default: console.log('Unhandled event type:', event.type); } return Response.json({ message: 'ok' }); } catch (error) { console.error('Invalid webhook signature:', error); return new Response('Invalid signature', { status: 400 }); } } ``` ### Verifying webhook payloads directly Permalink: Verifying webhook payloads directly In some cases, you may want to verify the webhook separately from parsing the payload. If you prefer to handle these steps separately, we provide the method `client.webhooks.verifySignature()` to _only verify_ the signature of a webhook request. Like `.unwrap()`, this method will throw an error if the signature is invalid. Note that the `body` parameter must be the raw JSON string sent from the server (do not parse it first). You will then need to parse the body after verifying the signature. ``` import { headers } from 'next/headers'; import OpenAI from 'openai'; const client = new OpenAI({ webhookSecret: process.env.OPENAI_WEBHOOK_SECRET, // env var used by default; explicit here. }); export async function webhook(request: Request) { const headersList = headers(); const body = await request.text(); try { client.webhooks.verifySignature(body, headersList); // Parse the body after verification const event = JSON.parse(body); console.log('Verified event:', event); return Response.json({ message: 'ok' }); } catch (error) { console.error('Invalid webhook signature:', error); return new Response('Invalid signature', { status: 400 }); } } ``` ## Handling errors Permalink: Handling errors When the library is unable to connect to the API, or if the API returns a non-success status code (i.e., 4xx or 5xx response), a subclass of `APIError` will be thrown: ``` const job = await client.fineTuning.jobs .create({ model: 'gpt-4o', training_file: 'file-abc123' }) .catch(async (err) => { if (err instanceof OpenAI.APIError) { console.log(err.request_id); console.log(err.status); // 400 console.log(err.name); // BadRequestError console.log(err.headers); // {server: 'nginx', ...} } else { throw err; } }); ``` Error codes are as follows: | Status Code | Error Type | | --- | --- | | 400 | `BadRequestError` | | 401 | `AuthenticationError` | | 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | | 404 | `NotFoundError` | | 422 | `UnprocessableEntityError` | | 429 | `RateLimitError` | | >=500 | `InternalServerError` | | N/A | `APIConnectionError` | ### Retries Permalink: Retries Certain errors will be automatically retried 2 times by default, with a short exponential backoff. Connection errors (for example, due to a network connectivity problem), 408 Request Timeout, 409 Conflict, 429 Rate Limit, and >=500 Internal errors will all be retried by default. You can use the `maxRetries` option to configure or disable this: ``` // Configure the default for all requests: const client = new OpenAI({ maxRetries: 0, // default is 2 }); // Or, configure per-request: await client.chat.completions.create({ messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'How can I get the name of the current day in JavaScript?' }], model: 'gpt-5.5' }, { maxRetries: 5, }); ``` ### Timeouts Permalink: Timeouts Requests time out after 10 minutes by default. You can configure this with a `timeout` option: ``` // Configure the default for all requests: const client = new OpenAI({ timeout: 20 * 1000, // 20 seconds (default is 10 minutes) }); // Override per-request: await client.chat.completions.create({ messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'How can I list all files in a directory using Python?' }], model: 'gpt-5.5' }, { timeout: 5 * 1000, }); ``` On timeout, an `APIConnectionTimeoutError` is thrown. Note that requests which time out will be retried twice by default. ## Request IDs Permalink: Request IDs > For more information on debugging requests, see these docs All object responses in the SDK provide a `_request_id` property which is added from the `x-request-id` response header so that you can quickly log failing requests and report them back to OpenAI. ``` const response = await client.responses.create({ model: 'gpt-5.5', input: 'testing 123' }); console.log(response._request_id); // req_123 ``` You can also access the Request ID using the `.withResponse()` method: ``` const { data: stream, request_id } = await openai.responses .create({ model: 'gpt-5.5', input: 'Say this is a test', stream: true, }) .withResponse(); ``` ## Auto-pagination Permalink: Auto-pagination List methods in the OpenAI API are paginated. You can use the `for await … of` syntax to iterate through items across all pages: ``` async function fetchAllFineTuningJobs(params) { const allFineTuningJobs = []; // Automatically fetches more pages as needed. for await (const fineTuningJob of client.fineTuning.jobs.list({ limit: 20 })) { allFineTuningJobs.push(fineTuningJob); } return allFineTuningJobs; } ``` Alternatively, you can request a single page at a time: ``` let page = await client.fineTuning.jobs.list({ limit: 20 }); for (const fineTuningJob of page.data) { console.log(fineTuningJob); } // Convenience methods are provided for manually paginating: while (page.hasNextPage()) { page = await page.getNextPage(); // ... } ``` ## Realtime API Permalink: Realtime API The Realtime API enables you to build low-latency, multi-modal conversational experiences. It currently supports text and audio as both input and output, as well as function calling through a `WebSocket` connection. ``` import { OpenAIRealtimeWebSocket } from 'openai/realtime/websocket'; const rt = new OpenAIRealtimeWebSocket({ model: 'gpt-realtime-2' }); rt.on('response.output_text.delta', (event) => process.stdout.write(event.delta)); ``` For more information see realtime.md. ## Microsoft Azure OpenAI Permalink: Microsoft Azure OpenAI To use this library with Azure OpenAI, use the `AzureOpenAI` class instead of the `OpenAI` class. Important The Azure API shape slightly differs from the core API shape which means that the static types for responses / params won't always be correct. ``` import { AzureOpenAI } from 'openai'; import { getBearerTokenProvider, DefaultAzureCredential } from '@azure/identity'; const credential = new DefaultAzureCredential(); const scope = 'https://cognitiveservices.azure.com/.default'; const azureADTokenProvider = getBearerTokenProvider(credential, scope); const openai = new AzureOpenAI({ azureADTokenProvider, apiVersion: '', }); const result = await openai.chat.completions.create({ model: 'gpt-5.5', messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'Say hello!' }], }); console.log(result.choices[0]!.message?.content); ``` For more information on support for the Azure API, see azure.md. ## Amazon Bedrock Permalink: Amazon Bedrock To use this library with Amazon Bedrock's OpenAI-compatible API, configure the standard `OpenAI` client with the Bedrock provider: ``` import OpenAI from 'openai'; import { bedrock } from 'openai/providers/bedrock/aws'; const client = new OpenAI({ provider: bedrock({ region: 'us-west-2' }), }); const response = await client.responses.create({ model: 'openai.gpt-5.4', input: 'Say hello!', }); console.log(response.output_text); ``` Use a model that supports the Responses API. A model returned by the Models API may support a different Bedrock inference API instead. This uses the regional `https://bedrock-mantle..api.aws/openai/v1` endpoint. The region can also come from `AWS_REGION` or `AWS_DEFAULT_REGION`, and `AWS_BEDROCK_BASE_URL` can override the endpoint. The AWS entrypoint uses the standard AWS credential chain by default. It also accepts a named profile, static credentials, or a custom credential provider. Install its peer dependencies before importing it: ``` npm install @aws-sdk/credential-provider-node @smithy/hash-node @smithy/signature-v4 ``` The AWS entrypoint uses normal static imports so bundlers and serverless packagers can trace these dependencies. If one is missing, importing `openai/providers/bedrock/aws` fails immediately with the runtime's normal module-not-found error, for example: ``` Cannot find module '@aws-sdk/credential-provider-node' ``` For Bedrock API key authentication, import `bedrock` from `openai/providers/bedrock` instead. That entrypoint has no AWS dependencies and works in browser-compatible runtimes when `dangerouslyAllowBrowser` is enabled. SigV4 authentication is supported in Node.js and compatible server runtimes and requires replayable request bodies. The legacy, bearer-only `BedrockOpenAI` class remains available for compatibility. For more information on support for Amazon Bedrock, see bedrock.md. ## Advanced Usage Permalink: Advanced Usage ### Accessing raw Response data (e.g., headers) Permalink: Accessing raw Response data (e.g., headers) The "raw" `Response` returned by `fetch()` can be accessed through the `.asResponse()` method on the `APIPromise` type that all methods return. This method returns as soon as the headers for a successful response are received and does not consume the response body, so you are free to write custom parsing or streaming logic. You can also use the `.withResponse()` method to get the raw `Response` along with the parsed data. Unlike `.asResponse()` this method consumes the body, returning once it is parsed. ``` const client = new OpenAI(); const httpResponse = await client.responses .create({ model: 'gpt-5.5', input: 'say this is a test.' }) .asResponse(); // access the underlying web standard Response object console.log(httpResponse.headers.get('X-My-Header')); console.log(httpResponse.statusText); const { data: modelResponse, response: raw } = await client.responses .create({ model: 'gpt-5.5', input: 'say this is a test.' }) .withResponse(); console.log(raw.headers.get('X-My-Header')); console.log(modelResponse); ``` ### Logging Permalink: Logging Important All log messages are intended for debugging only. The format and content of log messages may change between releases. #### Log levels Permalink: Log levels The log level can be configured in two ways: 1. Via the `OPENAI_LOG` environment variable 2. Using the `logLevel` client option (overrides the environment variable if set) ``` import OpenAI from 'openai'; const client = new OpenAI({ logLevel: 'debug', // Show all log messages }); ``` Available log levels, from most to least verbose: - `'debug'` \- Show debug messages, info, warnings, and errors - `'info'` \- Show info messages, warnings, and errors - `'warn'` \- Show warnings and errors (default) - `'error'` \- Show only errors - `'off'` \- Disable all logging At the `'debug'` level, all HTTP requests and responses are logged, including headers and bodies. Some authentication-related headers are redacted, but sensitive data in request and response bodies may still be visible. #### Custom logger Permalink: Custom logger By default, this library logs to `globalThis.console`. You can also provide a custom logger. Most logging libraries are supported, including pino, winston, bunyan, consola, and signale. If your logger doesn't work, please open an issue. When providing a custom logger, the `logLevel` option still controls which messages are emitted, messages below the configured level will not be sent to your logger. ``` import OpenAI from 'openai'; import pino from 'pino'; const logger = pino(); const client = new OpenAI({ logger: logger.child({ name: 'OpenAI' }), logLevel: 'debug', // Send all messages to pino, allowing it to filter }); ``` ### Making custom/undocumented requests Permalink: Making custom/undocumented requests This library is typed for convenient access to the documented API. If you need to access undocumented endpoints, params, or response properties, the library can still be used. #### Undocumented endpoints Permalink: Undocumented endpoints To make requests to undocumented endpoints, you can use `client.get`, `client.post`, and other HTTP verbs. Options on the client, such as retries, will be respected when making these requests. ``` await client.post('/some/path', { body: { some_prop: 'foo' }, query: { some_query_arg: 'bar' }, }); ``` #### Undocumented request params Permalink: Undocumented request params To make requests using undocumented parameters, you may use `// @ts-expect-error` on the undocumented parameter. This library doesn't validate at runtime that the request matches the type, so any extra values you send will be sent as-is. ``` client.chat.completions.create({ // ... // @ts-expect-error baz is not yet public baz: 'undocumented option', }); ``` For requests with the `GET` verb, any extra params will be in the query, all other requests will send the extra param in the body. For enrollment, certificate requirements, activation, and supported endpoints, see the OpenAI Mutual TLS Beta Program. Configure mTLS on your runtime's HTTP transport, then pass that transport to the SDK with `fetch` and `fetchOptions`. Set `baseURL` to the mTLS endpoint explicitly: ``` import { readFile } from 'node:fs/promises'; import { Agent, fetch as undiciFetch } from 'undici'; import OpenAI from 'openai'; const dispatcher = new Agent({ connect: { // One PEM chain: leaf certificate first, then required intermediates. cert: await readFile('/path/to/client-cert-chain.pem'), key: await readFile('/path/to/client-key.pem'), }, }); const client = new OpenAI({ apiKey: process.env['OPENAI_API_KEY'], baseURL: 'https://mtls.api.openai.com/v1', fetch: undiciFetch, fetchOptions: { dispatcher, redirect: 'manual', }, }); ``` Use `https://mtls-eu.api.openai.com/v1` for EU Data Residency. The example uses manual redirects so the certificate-bearing transport does not automatically follow a redirect to another host. Close transports your application creates when they are no longer needed. See the runnable Node.js, Deno, and Bun mTLS examples for certificate-chain setup, optional Node.js encrypted-key support, and runtime-specific transport cleanup. ## Frequently Asked Questions Permalink: Frequently Asked Questions ## Semantic versioning Permalink: Semantic versioning This package generally follows SemVer conventions, though certain backwards-incompatible changes may be released as minor versions: 1. # 🤖 Generador de CV con IA - Implementación Completa

## SOLUCIÓN INTEGRAL: Backend + Frontend + IA

Tu página no funciona porque falta el **backend que conecta con la API de IA**. Aquí está la solución completa:

---

## 📁 ESTRUCTURA DEL PROYECTO

```
cv-generator/
├── backend/
│   ├── main.py                 # API FastAPI
│   ├── ai_service.py          # Servicio de IA
│   ├── requirements.txt
│   └── .env                   # API keys
├── frontend/
│   ├── index.html
│   ├── css/
│   │   └── styles.css
│   └── js/
│       ├── app.js             # Lógica principal
│       ├── ai-generator.js    # Cliente de IA
│       └── pdf-export.js      # Exportación PDF
└── README.md
```

---

## 🔧 BACKEND: API con FastAPI

### `backend/main.py`

```python
"""
API Backend para Generador de CV con IA
Compatible con OpenAI, Anthropic Claude y modelos locales
"""

from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException
from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Optional, List, Dict, Any
import os
from dotenv import load_dotenv
from ai_service import AIGenerator
import logging

# Configurar logging
logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO)
logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

# Cargar variables de entorno
load_dotenv()

app = FastAPI(
    title="NOIACORE CV Generator API",
    description="API para generación de CVs con inteligencia artificial",
    version="1.0.0"
)

# Configurar CORS para permitir peticiones desde el frontend
app.add_middleware(
    CORSMiddleware,
    allow_origins=[
        "http://localhost:3000",
        "http://localhost:5173",
        "https://manosasbiertas.noiacore.es"  # Dominio de producción
    ],
    allow_credentials=True,
    allow_methods=["*"],
    allow_headers=["*"],
)

# Inicializar generador de IA
ai_generator = AIGenerator(
    provider=os.getenv("AI_PROVIDER", "openai"),  # openai, anthropic, gemini, ollama
    api_key=os.getenv("AI_API_KEY"),
    model=os.getenv("AI_MODEL", "gpt-4o-mini")
)

# Modelos de datos Pydantic
class PersonalInfo(BaseModel):
    name: str = Field(default="", description="Nombre completo")
    title: str = Field(default="", description="Título profesional")
    email: str = Field(default="", description="Correo electrónico")
    phone: str = Field(default="", description="Teléfono")
    address: str = Field(default="", description="Dirección")

class Experience(BaseModel):
    position: str = Field(default="", description="Puesto de trabajo")
    company: str = Field(default="", description="Empresa")
    start_date: str = Field(default="", description="Fecha inicio")
    end_date: str = Field(default="", description="Fecha fin")
    description: str = Field(default="", description="Descripción del puesto")
    responsibilities: List[str] = Field(default=[], description="Responsabilidades")

class Education(BaseModel):
    degree: str = Field(default="", description="Título académico")
    institution: str = Field(default="", description="Institución")
    year: str = Field(default="", description="Año de finalización")
    description: str = Field(default="", description="Descripción")

class CVData(BaseModel):
    personal: PersonalInfo
    profile: str = Field(default="", description="Perfil profesional")
    experiences: List[Experience] = Field(default=[])
    education: List[Education] = Field(default=[])
    skills: List[str] = Field(default=[])
    languages: List[Dict[str, str]] = Field(default=[])

class GenerateRequest(BaseModel):
    section: str = Field(..., description="Sección a generar: profile, experience, skills, etc.")
    cv_data: CVData
    context: Optional[str] = Field(default="", description="Contexto adicional")
    language: str = Field(default="es", description="Idioma del contenido")

class GenerateResponse(BaseModel):
    success: bool
    content: str
    error: Optional[str] = None
    tokens_used: Optional[int] = None

# Endpoints
@app.get("/")
async def root():
    """Endpoint de salud"""
    return {
        "status": "ok",
        "service": "NOIACORE CV Generator API",
        "version": "1.0.0"
    }

@app.post("/api/generate", response_model=GenerateResponse)
async def generate_content(request: GenerateRequest):
    """
    Genera contenido para una sección específica del CV usando IA
    """
    try:
        logger.info(f"Generando contenido para sección: {request.section}")
        
        # Generar contenido según la sección
        if request.section == "profile":
            content = await ai_generator.generate_profile(
                request.cv_data,
                request.language
            )
        elif request.section == "experience":
            content = await ai_generator.generate_experience_description(
                request.cv_data.experiences[-1] if request.cv_data.experiences else None,
                request.language
            )
        elif request.section == "skills":
            content = await ai_generator.generate_skills(
                request.cv_data,
                request.language
            )
        elif request.section == "responsibilities":
            content = await ai_generator.generate_responsibilities(
                request.cv_data.experiences[-1] if request.cv_data.experiences else None,
                request.language
            )
        else:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=400,
                detail=f"Sección no soportada: {request.section}"
            )
        
        return GenerateResponse(
            success=True,
            content=content,
            tokens_used=None
        )
        
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"Error generando contenido: {str(e)}")
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=500,
            detail=f"Error generando contenido: {str(e)}"
        )

@app.post("/api/improve")
async def improve_text(request: dict):
    """
    Mejora un texto existente usando IA
    """
    try:
        text = request.get("text", "")
        context = request.get("context", "CV profesional")
        language = request.get("language", "es")
        
        improved = await ai_generator.improve_text(text, context, language)
        
        return {
            "success": True,
            "original": text,
            "improved": improved
        }
        
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"Error mejorando texto: {str(e)}")
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(e))

@app.get("/api/models")
async def list_models():
    """
    Lista los modelos de IA disponibles
    """
    return {
        "available_models": ai_generator.get_available_models(),
        "current_provider": ai_generator.provider,
        "current_model": ai_generator.model
    }

if __name__ == "__main__":
    import uvicorn
    uvicorn.run(
        "main:app",
        host="0.0.0.0",
        port=8000,
        reload=True
    )
```

### `backend/ai_service.py`

```python
"""
Servicio de IA para generación de contenido
Soporta múltiples proveedores: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Ollama
"""

import os
from typing import Optional, List, Dict
import json
from abc import ABC, abstractmethod

class AIProvider(ABC):
    """Clase base para proveedores de IA"""
    
    @abstractmethod
    async def generate(self, prompt: str, max_tokens: int = 500) -> str:
        pass

class OpenAIProvider(AIProvider):
    """Proveedor OpenAI (GPT-4o, GPT-4o-mini)"""
    
    def __init__(self, api_key: str, model: str = "gpt-4o-mini"):
        self.api_key = api_key
        self.model = model
        
        try:
            from openai import OpenAI
            self.client = OpenAI(api_key=api_key)
        except ImportError:
            raise ImportError("Instala openai: pip install openai")
    
    async def generate(self, prompt: str, max_tokens: int = 500) -> str:
        response = self.client.chat.completions.create(
            model=self.model,
            messages=[
                {"role": "system", "content": "Eres un experto en redacción de CVs profesionales en español. Genera contenido claro, conciso y orientado a resultados."},
                {"role": "user", "content": prompt}
            ],
            max_tokens=max_tokens,
            temperature=0.7
        )
        return response.choices[0].message.content.strip()

class AnthropicProvider(AIProvider):
    """Proveedor Anthropic (Claude)"""
    
    def __init__(self, api_key: str, model: str = "claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022"):
        self.api_key = api_key
        self.model = model
        
        try:
            import anthropic
            self.client = anthropic.Anthropic(api_key=api_key)
        except ImportError:
            raise ImportError("Instala anthropic: pip install anthropic")
    
    async def generate(self, prompt: str, max_tokens: int = 500) -> str:
        message = self.client.messages.create(
            model=self.model,
            max_tokens=max_tokens,
            messages=[

/**
 * Cliente de IA para Generador de CV
 * Maneja comunicación con backend y generación de contenido
 */

class AIGenerator {
  constructor(apiBaseUrl = 'http://localhost:8000') {
    this.apiBaseUrl = apiBaseUrl;
    this.loadingElement = null;
    this.isGenerating = false;
  }

  /**
   * Genera contenido para una sección específica del CV
   * @param {string} section - Sección a generar (profile, experience, skills, etc.)
   * @param {Object} cvData - Datos actuales del CV
   * @param {string} language - Idioma del contenido
   * @returns {Promise<string>} - Contenido generado
   */
  async generateContent(section, cvData, language = 'es') {
    if (this.isGenerating) {
      console.warn('Ya hay una generación en progreso');
      return null;
    }

    this.isGenerating = true;
    this.showLoading(true);

    try {
      const response = await fetch(`${this.apiBaseUrl}/api/generate`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          section: section,
          cv_data: cvData,
          language: language
        })
      });

      if (!response.ok) {
        const errorData = await response.json();
        throw new Error(errorData.detail || 'Error generando contenido');
      }

      const data = await response.json();
      
      if (!data.success) {
        throw new Error(data.error || 'Error desconocido');
      }

      return data.content;

    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error en generación de IA:', error);
      this.showError(error.message);
      throw error;
    } finally {
      this.isGenerating = false;
      this.showLoading(false);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Genera perfil profesional
   */
  async generateProfile(cvData) {
    return await this.generateContent('profile', cvData);
  }

  /**

  async generateExperienceDescription(cvData) {
    return await this.generateContent('experience', cvData);
  }

   */
  async generateResponsibilities(cvData) {
    const responsibilities = await this.generateContent('responsibilities', cvData);
    
    // Si viene como string, convertir a array
    if (typeof responsibilities === 'string') {
      return responsibilities.split('\n').filter(line => line.trim());
    }
    
    return responsibilities;
  }

  /**
   * Genera habilidades profesionales
   */
  async generateSkills(cvData) {
    const skills = await this.generateContent('skills', cvData);
    
    if (typeof skills === 'string') {
      return skills.split('\n').filter(line => line.trim());
    }
    
    return skills;
  }

   */
  async improveText(text, context = 'CV profesional') {

        headers: {

        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          text: text,
          context: context,
          language: 'es'
        })
      });

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error('Error mejorando texto');
      }

      const data = await response.json();
      return data.improved;

      console.error('Error mejorando texto:', error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

      return response.ok;
    } catch (error) {
      return false;
    }

   */
  async getAvailableModels() {

      return null;

   */

    if (!this.loadingElement) {
      this.loadingElement = document.getElementById('ai-loading');
    }

    if (this.loadingElement) {
      this.loadingElement.style.display = show ? 'flex' : 'none';
    }

    // Deshabilitar botones de generación
    const generateButtons = document.querySelectorAll('[data-generate-section]');
    generateButtons.forEach(btn => {
      btn.disabled = show;
      btn.style.opacity = show ? '0.5' : '1';
    });
  }

  /**
   * Muestra mensaje de error
   */
  showError(message) {
    // Crear notificación de error
    const errorDiv = document.createElement('div');
    errorDiv.className = 'ai-error-notification';
    errorDiv.innerHTML = `
      <div class="error-content">
        <span class="error-icon">⚠️</span>
        <span class="error-message">${message}</span>
        <button class="error-close" onclick="this.parentElement.parentElement.remove()">×</button>
      </div>
    `;

    document.body.appendChild(errorDiv);

    // Auto-eliminar después de 5 segundos
    setTimeout(() => {
      errorDiv.remove();
    }, 5000);
  }

/**
 * Exportación de CV a PDF
 * Usa html2pdf.js para generar PDF de alta calidad
 */

async function generatePDF(cvData) {
  try {
    // Verificar que html2pdf esté cargado
    if (typeof html2pdf === 'undefined') {
      alert('Cargando librería PDF...');
      await loadHTML2PDF();
    }

    const element = document.getElementById('cv-preview');
    
    if (!element) {
      alert('No se encontró la vista previa del CV');
      return;
    }

    // Opciones de configuración
    const options = {
      margin: 10,
      filename: `${cvData.personal.name || 'CV'}_Curriculum.pdf`,
      image: { type: 'jpeg', quality: 0.98 },
      html2canvas: { 
        scale: 2,
        useCORS: true,
        letterRendering: true
      },
      jsPDF: { 
        unit: 'mm', 
        format: 'a4', 
        orientation: 'portrait'
      },
      pagebreak: { 
        mode: ['avoid-all', 'css', 'legacy'] 
      }
    };

    // Generar PDF
    const pdfBlob = await html2pdf().from(element).set(options).outputPdf('blob');
    
    // Descargar archivo
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(pdfBlob);
    const link = document.createElement('a');
    link.href = url;
    link.download = options.filename;
    link.click();
    
    // Limpiar URL temporal
    setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 100);

    console.log('PDF generado exitosamente');

  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error generando PDF:', error);
    alert('Error al generar PDF. Intenta imprimir y guardar como PDF.');
  }
}

/**
 * Carga dinámicamente html2pdf.js
 */
async function loadHTML2PDF() {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const script = document.createElement('script');
    script.src = 'https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/html2pdf.js/0.10.1/html2pdf.bundle.min.js';
    script.onload = resolve;
    script.onerror = reject;
    document.head.appendChild(script);
  });
}

// Exportar función globalmente
window.generatePDF = generatePDF;

content: Construyendo un entorno de aprendizaje transformador para mayores sin experiencia tecnológica

Estoy diseñando una plataforma educativa inclusiva que fusiona pedagogía activa, inteligencia artificial sensible y redes humanas para empoderar a personas de 40 años en adelante.  
El proyecto, llamado NO.IA_CORE, se articula como un ecosistema vivo donde el conocimiento fluye desde la experiencia cotidiana hacia herramientas digitales accesibles, guiadas por mentores comunitarios y experiencias colaborativas.  
Cada elemento —desde las metodologías de enseñanza hasta los prototipos de interfaces— está pensado con intención: acercar lo desconocido al corazón del sentido común, cultivando confianza, curiosidad y pertenencia.

import { azureManagedIdentityTokenProvider } from 'openai/auth'; const client = new OpenAI({ workloadIdentity: { identityProviderId: 'idp-123', serviceAccountId: 'sa-456', provider: azureManagedIdentityTokenProvider(), }, }); ``` ### GCP (compute engine metadata) Permalink: GCP (compute engine metadata) ``` import OpenAI from 'openai'; import { gcpIDTokenProvider } from 'openai/auth'; const client = new OpenAI({ workloadIdentity: { identityProviderId: 'idp-123', serviceAccountId: 'sa-456', provider: gcpIDTokenProvider(), }, }); }, }, }, }); ``` You can also customize the token refresh buffer (default is 1200 seconds (20 minutes) before expiration): ``` import OpenAI from 'openai'; import { k8sServiceAccountTokenProvider } from 'openai/auth'; const client = new OpenAI({ workloadIdentity: { identityProviderId: 'idp-123', serviceAccountId: 'sa-456', provider: k8sServiceAccountTokenProvider('/var/token'), refreshBufferSeconds: 120.0, }, }); ``` ## Streaming responses Permalink: Streaming responses We provide support for streaming responses using Server-Sent Events (SSE). ``` import OpenAI from 'openai'; const client = new OpenAI(); const stream = await client.responses.create({ model: 'gpt-5.5', input: 'Say "Sheep sleep deep" ten times fast!', stream: true, }); for await (const event of stream) { console.log(event); } ``` ## File uploads Permalink: File uploads Request parameters that correspond to file uploads can be passed in many different forms: - `File` (or an object with the same structure) - a `fetch``Response` (or an object with the same structure) - an `fs.ReadStream` - the return value of our `toFile` or `toStreamingFile` helpers ``` import fs from 'fs'; import OpenAI, { toFile, toStreamingFile } from 'openai'; const client = new OpenAI(); // If you have access to Node `fs` we recommend using `fs.createReadStream()`: await client.files.create({ file: fs.createReadStream('input.jsonl'), purpose: 'fine-tune' }); // Or if you have the web `File` API you can pass a `File` instance: await client.files.create({ file: new File(['my bytes'], 'input.jsonl'), purpose: 'fine-tune' }); // You can also pass a `fetch` `Response`: await client.files.create({ file: await fetch('https://somesite/input.jsonl'), purpose: 'fine-tune', }); // Finally, if none of the above are convenient, you can use our `toFile` helper: await client.files.create({ file: await toFile(Buffer.from('my bytes'), 'input.jsonl'), purpose: 'fine-tune', }); await client.files.create({ file: await toFile(new Uint8Array([0, 1, 2]), 'input.jsonl'), purpose: 'fine-tune', }); // `toFile()` creates a web File, so it must buffer stream inputs before sending them. // Use `toStreamingFile()` to stream an arbitrary web, Node, or cloud-storage stream directly: await client.files.create({ file: toStreamingFile(myReadableStream, 'input.jsonl', { type: 'application/jsonl' }), purpose: 'fine-tune', }); ``` ## Webhook Verification Permalink: Webhook Verification Verifying webhook signatures is _optional but encouraged_. For more information about webhooks, see the API docs. ### Parsing webhook payloads Permalink: Parsing webhook payloads For most use cases, you will likely want to verify the webhook and parse the payload at the same time. To achieve this, we provide the method `client.webhooks.unwrap()`, which parses a webhook request and verifies that it was sent by OpenAI. This method will throw an error if the signature is invalid. Note that the `body` parameter must be the raw JSON string sent from the server (do not parse it first). The `.unwrap()` method will parse this JSON for you into an event object after verifying the webhook was sent from OpenAI. ``` import { headers } from 'next/headers'; import OpenAI from 'openai'; const client = new OpenAI({ webhookSecret: process.env.OPENAI_WEBHOOK_SECRET, // env var used by default; explicit here. }); export async function webhook(request: Request) { const headersList = headers(); const body = await request.text(); try { const event = client.webhooks.unwrap(body, headersList); switch (event.type) { case 'response.completed': console.log('Response completed:', event.data); break; case 'response.failed': console.log('Response failed:', event.data); break; default: console.log('Unhandled event type:', event.type); } return Response.json({ message: 'ok' }); } catch (error) { console.error('Invalid webhook signature:', error); return new Response('Invalid signature', { status: 400 }); } } ``` ### Verifying webhook payloads directly Permalink: Verifying webhook payloads directly In some cases, you may want to verify the webhook separately from parsing the payload. If you prefer to handle these steps separately, we provide the method `client.webhooks.verifySignature()` to _only verify_ the signature of a webhook request. Like `.unwrap()`, this method will throw an error if the signature is invalid. Note that the `body` parameter must be the raw JSON string sent from the server (do not parse it first). You will then need to parse the body after verifying the signature. ``` import { headers } from 'next/headers'; import OpenAI from 'openai'; const client = new OpenAI({ webhookSecret: process.env.OPENAI_WEBHOOK_SECRET, // env var used by default; explicit here. }); export async function webhook(request: Request) { const headersList = headers(); const body = await request.text(); try { client.webhooks.verifySignature(body, headersList); // Parse the body after verification const event = JSON.parse(body); console.log('Verified event:', event); return Response.json({ message: 'ok' }); } catch (error) { console.error('Invalid webhook signature:', error); return new Response('Invalid signature', { status: 400 }); } } ``` ## Handling errors Permalink: Handling errors When the library is unable to connect to the API, or if the API returns a non-success status code (i.e., 4xx or 5xx response), a subclass of `APIError` will be thrown: ``` const job = await client.fineTuning.jobs .create({ model: 'gpt-4o', training_file: 'file-abc123' }) .catch(async (err) => { if (err instanceof OpenAI.APIError) { console.log(err.request_id); console.log(err.status); // 400 console.log(err.name); // BadRequestError console.log(err.headers); // {server: 'nginx', ...} } else { throw err; } }); ``` Error codes are as follows: | Status Code | Error Type | | --- | --- | | 400 | `BadRequestError` | | 401 | `AuthenticationError` | | 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | | 404 | `NotFoundError` | | 422 | `UnprocessableEntityError` | | 429 | `RateLimitError` | | >=500 | `InternalServerError` | | N/A | `APIConnectionError` | ### Retries Permalink: Retries Certain errors will be automatically retried 2 times by default, with a short exponential backoff. Connection errors (for example, due to a network connectivity problem), 408 Request Timeout, 409 Conflict, 429 Rate Limit, and >=500 Internal errors will all be retried by default. You can use the `maxRetries` option to configure or disable this: ``` // Configure the default for all requests: const client = new OpenAI({ maxRetries: 0, // default is 2 }); // Or, configure per-request: await client.chat.completions.create({ messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'How can I get the name of the current day in JavaScript?' }], model: 'gpt-5.5' }, { maxRetries: 5, }); ``` ### Timeouts Permalink: Timeouts Requests time out after 10 minutes by default. You can configure this with a `timeout` option: ``` // Configure the default for all requests: const client = new OpenAI({ timeout: 20 * 1000, // 20 seconds (default is 10 minutes) }); // Override per-request: await client.chat.completions.create({ messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'How can I list all files in a directory using Python?' }], model: 'gpt-5.5' }, { timeout: 5 * 1000, }); ``` On timeout, an `APIConnectionTimeoutError` is thrown. Note that requests which time out will be retried twice by default. ## Request IDs Permalink: Request IDs > For more information on debugging requests, see these docs All object responses in the SDK provide a `_request_id` property which is added from the `x-request-id` response header so that you can quickly log failing requests and report them back to OpenAI. ``` const response = await client.responses.create({ model: 'gpt-5.5', input: 'testing 123' }); console.log(response._request_id); // req_123 ``` You can also access the Request ID using the `.withResponse()` method: ``` const { data: stream, request_id } = await openai.responses .create({ model: 'gpt-5.5', input: 'Say this is a test', stream: true, }) .withResponse(); ``` ## Auto-pagination Permalink: Auto-pagination List methods in the OpenAI API are paginated. You can use the `for await … of` syntax to iterate through items across all pages: ``` async function fetchAllFineTuningJobs(params) { const allFineTuningJobs = []; // Automatically fetches more pages as needed. for await (const fineTuningJob of client.fineTuning.jobs.list({ limit: 20 })) { allFineTuningJobs.push(fineTuningJob); } return allFineTuningJobs; } ``` Alternatively, you can request a single page at a time: ``` let page = await client.fineTuning.jobs.list({ limit: 20 }); for (const fineTuningJob of page.data) { console.log(fineTuningJob); } // Convenience methods are provided for manually paginating: while (page.hasNextPage()) { page = await page.getNextPage(); // ... } ``` ## Realtime API Permalink: Realtime API The Realtime API enables you to build low-latency, multi-modal conversational experiences. It currently supports text and audio as both input and output, as well as function calling through a `WebSocket` connection. ``` import { OpenAIRealtimeWebSocket } from 'openai/realtime/websocket'; const rt = new OpenAIRealtimeWebSocket({ model: 'gpt-realtime-2' }); rt.on('response.output_text.delta', (event) => process.stdout.write(event.delta)); ``` For more information see realtime.md. ## Microsoft Azure OpenAI Permalink: Microsoft Azure OpenAI To use this library with Azure OpenAI, use the `AzureOpenAI` class instead of the `OpenAI` class. Important The Azure API shape slightly differs from the core API shape which means that the static types for responses / params won't always be correct. ``` import { AzureOpenAI } from 'openai'; import { getBearerTokenProvider, DefaultAzureCredential } from '@azure/identity'; const credential = new DefaultAzureCredential(); const scope = 'https://cognitiveservices.azure.com/.default'; const azureADTokenProvider = getBearerTokenProvider(credential, scope); const openai = new AzureOpenAI({ azureADTokenProvider, apiVersion: '', }); const result = await openai.chat.completions.create({ model: 'gpt-5.5', messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'Say hello!' }], }); console.log(result.choices[0]!.message?.content); ``` For more information on support for the Azure API, see azure.md. ## Amazon Bedrock Permalink: Amazon Bedrock To use this library with Amazon Bedrock's OpenAI-compatible API, configure the standard `OpenAI` client with the Bedrock provider: ``` import OpenAI from 'openai'; import { bedrock } from 'openai/providers/bedrock/aws'; const client = new OpenAI({ provider: bedrock({ region: 'us-west-2' }), }); const response = await client.responses.create({ model: 'openai.gpt-5.4', input: 'Say hello!', }); console.log(response.output_text); ``` Use a model that supports the Responses API. A model returned by the Models API may support a different Bedrock inference API instead. This uses the regional `https://bedrock-mantle..api.aws/openai/v1` endpoint. The region can also come from `AWS_REGION` or `AWS_DEFAULT_REGION`, and `AWS_BEDROCK_BASE_URL` can override the endpoint. The AWS entrypoint uses the standard AWS credential chain by default. It also accepts a named profile, static credentials, or a custom credential provider. Install its peer dependencies before importing it: ``` npm install @aws-sdk/credential-provider-node @smithy/hash-node @smithy/signature-v4 ``` The AWS entrypoint uses normal static imports so bundlers and serverless packagers can trace these dependencies. If one is missing, importing `openai/providers/bedrock/aws` fails immediately with the runtime's normal module-not-found error, for example: ``` Cannot find module '@aws-sdk/credential-provider-node' ``` For Bedrock API key authentication, import `bedrock` from `openai/providers/bedrock` instead. That entrypoint has no AWS dependencies and works in browser-compatible runtimes when `dangerouslyAllowBrowser` is enabled. SigV4 authentication is supported in Node.js and compatible server runtimes and requires replayable request bodies. The legacy, bearer-only `BedrockOpenAI` class remains available for compatibility. For more information on support for Amazon Bedrock, see bedrock.md. ## Advanced Usage Permalink: Advanced Usage ### Accessing raw Response data (e.g., headers) Permalink: Accessing raw Response data (e.g., headers) The "raw" `Response` returned by `fetch()` can be accessed through the `.asResponse()` method on the `APIPromise` type that all methods return. This method returns as soon as the headers for a successful response are received and does not consume the response body, so you are free to write custom parsing or streaming logic. You can also use the `.withResponse()` method to get the raw `Response` along with the parsed data. Unlike `.asResponse()` this method consumes the body, returning once it is parsed. ``` const client = new OpenAI(); const httpResponse = await client.responses .create({ model: 'gpt-5.5', input: 'say this is a test.' }) .asResponse(); // access the underlying web standard Response object console.log(httpResponse.headers.get('X-My-Header')); console.log(httpResponse.statusText); const { data: modelResponse, response: raw } = await client.responses .create({ model: 'gpt-5.5', input: 'say this is a test.' }) .withResponse(); console.log(raw.headers.get('X-My-Header')); console.log(modelResponse); ``` ### Logging Permalink: Logging Important All log messages are intended for debugging only. The format and content of log messages may change between releases. #### Log levels Permalink: Log levels The log level can be configured in two ways: 1. Via the `OPENAI_LOG` environment variable 2. Using the `logLevel` client option (overrides the environment variable if set) ``` import OpenAI from 'openai'; const client = new OpenAI({ logLevel: 'debug', // Show all log messages }); ``` Available log levels, from most to least verbose: - `'debug'` \- Show debug messages, info, warnings, and errors - `'info'` \- Show info messages, warnings, and errors - `'warn'` \- Show warnings and errors (default) - `'error'` \- Show only errors - `'off'` \- Disable all logging At the `'debug'` level, all HTTP requests and responses are logged, including headers and bodies. Some authentication-related headers are redacted, but sensitive data in request and response bodies may still be visible. #### Custom logger Permalink: Custom logger By default, this library logs to `globalThis.console`. You can also provide a custom logger. Most logging libraries are supported, including pino, winston, bunyan, consola, and signale. If your logger doesn't work, please open an issue. When providing a custom logger, the `logLevel` option still controls which messages are emitted, messages below the configured level will not be sent to your logger. ``` import OpenAI from 'openai'; import pino from 'pino'; const logger = pino(); const client = new OpenAI({ logger: logger.child({ name: 'OpenAI' }), logLevel: 'debug', // Send all messages to pino, allowing it to filter }); ``` ### Making custom/undocumented requests Permalink: Making custom/undocumented requests This library is typed for convenient access to the documented API. If you need to access undocumented endpoints, params, or response properties, the library can still be used. #### Undocumented endpoints Permalink: Undocumented endpoints To make requests to undocumented endpoints, you can use `client.get`, `client.post`, and other HTTP verbs. Options on the client, such as retries, will be respected when making these requests. ``` await client.post('/some/path', { body: { some_prop: 'foo' }, query: { some_query_arg: 'bar' }, }); ``` #### Undocumented request params Permalink: Undocumented request params To make requests using undocumented parameters, you may use `// @ts-expect-error` on the undocumented parameter. This library doesn't validate at runtime that the request matches the type, so any extra values you send will be sent as-is. ``` client.chat.completions.create({ // ... // @ts-expect-error baz is not yet public baz: 'undocumented option', }); ``` For requests with the `GET` verb, any extra params will be in the query, all other requests will send the extra param in the body. If you want to explicitly send an extra argument, you can do so with the `query`, `body`, and `headers` request options. #### Undocumented response properties Permalink: Undocumented response properties To access undocumented response properties, you may access the response object with `// @ts-expect-error` on the response object, or cast the response object to the requisite type. Like the request params, we do not validate or strip extra properties from the response from the API. ### Customizing the fetch client Permalink: Customizing the fetch client If you want to use a different `fetch` function, you can either polyfill the global: ``` import fetch from 'my-fetch'; globalThis.fetch = fetch; ``` Or pass it to the client: ``` import OpenAI from 'openai'; import fetch from 'my-fetch'; const client = new OpenAI({ fetch }); ``` ### Fetch options Permalink: Fetch options If you want to set custom `fetch` options without overriding the `fetch` function, you can provide a `fetchOptions` object when instantiating the client or making a request. (Request-specific options override client options.) ``` import OpenAI from 'openai'; const client = new OpenAI({ fetchOptions: { // `RequestInit` options }, }); ``` #### Configuring proxies Permalink: Configuring proxies To modify proxy behavior, you can provide custom `fetchOptions` that add runtime-specific proxy options to requests: **Node**\ [docs\] ``` import OpenAI from 'openai'; import { fetch, ProxyAgent } from 'undici'; const proxyAgent = new ProxyAgent('http://localhost:8888'); const client = new OpenAI({ fetch, fetchOptions: { dispatcher: proxyAgent, }, }); ``` Undici-specific options like `dispatcher` must be paired with the matching `fetch` implementation. **Bun**\ [docs\] ``` import OpenAI from 'openai'; const client = new OpenAI({ fetchOptions: { proxy: 'http://localhost:8888', }, }); ``` **Deno**\ [docs\] ``` import OpenAI from 'npm:openai'; const httpClient = Deno.createHttpClient({ proxy: { url: 'http://localhost:8888' } }); const client = new OpenAI({ fetchOptions: { client: httpClient, }, }); ``` ### Mutual TLS Permalink: Mutual TLS The API mTLS beta combines your API key with a client certificate. For enrollment, certificate requirements, activation, and supported endpoints, see the OpenAI Mutual TLS Beta Program. Configure mTLS on your runtime's HTTP transport, then pass that transport to the SDK with `fetch` and `fetchOptions`. Set `baseURL` to the mTLS endpoint explicitly: ``` import { readFile } from 'node:fs/promises'; import { Agent, fetch as undiciFetch } from 'undici'; import OpenAI from 'openai'; const dispatcher = new Agent({ connect: { // One PEM chain: leaf certificate first, then required intermediates. cert: await readFile('/path/to/client-cert-chain.pem'), key: await readFile('/path/to/client-key.pem'), }, }); const client = new OpenAI({ apiKey: process.env['OPENAI_API_KEY'], baseURL: 'https://mtls.api.openai.com/v1', fetch: undiciFetch, fetchOptions: { dispatcher, redirect: 'manual', }, }); ``` Use `https://mtls-eu.api.openai.com/v1` for EU Data Residency. The example uses manual redirects so the certificate-bearing transport does not automatically follow a redirect to another host. Close transports your application creates when they are no longer needed. See the runnable Node.js, Deno, and Bun mTLS examples for certificate-chain setup, optional Node.js encrypted-key support, and runtime-specific transport cleanup. ## Frequently Asked Questions Permalink: Frequently Asked Questions ## Semantic versioning Permalink: Semantic versioning This package generally follows SemVer conventions, though certain backwards-incompatible changes may be released as minor versions: 1. Enabling the `dangerouslyAllowBrowser` option can be dangerous because it exposes your secret API credentials in the client-side code. Web browsers are inherently less secure than server environments, any user with access to the browser can potentially inspect, extract, and misuse these credentials. This could lead to unauthorized access using your credentials and potentially compromise sensitive data or functionality. ### When might this not be dangerous? Permalink: When might this not be dangerous? """
API Backend para Generador de CV con IA
Compatible con OpenAI, Anthropic Claude y modelos locales
"""

from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException
from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Optional, List, Dict, Any
import os
from dotenv import load_dotenv
from ai_service import AIGenerator
import logging

# Configurar logging
logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO)
logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

# Cargar variables de entorno
load_dotenv()

app = FastAPI(
    title="NOIACORE CV Generator API",
    description="API para generación de CVs con inteligencia artificial",
    version="1.0.0"
)

# Configurar CORS para permitir peticiones desde el frontend
app.add_middleware(
    CORSMiddleware,
    allow_origins=[
        "http://localhost:3000",
        "http://localhost:5173",
        "https://manosasbiertas.noiacore.es"  # Dominio de producción
    ],
    allow_credentials=True,
    allow_methods=["*"],
    allow_headers=["*"],
)

# Inicializar generador de IA
ai_generator = AIGenerator(
    provider=os.getenv("AI_PROVIDER", "openai"),  # openai, anthropic, gemini, ollama
    api_key=os.getenv("AI_API_KEY"),
    model=os.getenv("AI_MODEL", "gpt-4o-mini")
)

# Modelos de datos Pydantic
class PersonalInfo(BaseModel):
    name: str = Field(default="", description="Nombre completo")
    title: str = Field(default="", description="Título profesional")
    email: str = Field(default="", description="Correo electrónico")
    phone: str = Field(default="", description="Teléfono")
    address: str = Field(default="", description="Dirección")

class Experience(BaseModel):
    position: str = Field(default="", description="Puesto de trabajo")
    company: str = Field(default="", description="Empresa")
    start_date: str = Field(default="", description="Fecha inicio")
    end_date: str = Field(default="", description="Fecha fin")
    description: str = Field(default="", description="Descripción del puesto")
    responsibilities: List[str] = Field(default=[], description="Responsabilidades")

class Education(BaseModel):
    degree: str = Field(default="", description="Título académico")
    institution: str = Field(default="", description="Institución")
    year: str = Field(default="", description="Año de finalización")
    description: str = Field(default="", description="Descripción")

class CVData(BaseModel):
    personal: PersonalInfo
    profile: str = Field(default="", description="Perfil profesional")
    experiences: List[Experience] = Field(default=[])
    education: List[Education] = Field(default=[])
    skills: List[str] = Field(default=[])
    languages: List[Dict[str, str]] = Field(default=[])

class GenerateRequest(BaseModel):
    section: str = Field(..., description="Sección a generar: profile, experience, skills, etc.")
    cv_data: CVData
    context: Optional[str] = Field(default="", description="Contexto adicional")
    language: str = Field(default="es", description="Idioma del contenido")

class GenerateResponse(BaseModel):
    success: bool
    content: str
    error: Optional[str] = None
    tokens_used: Optional[int] = None

# Endpoints
@app.get("/")
async def root():
    """Endpoint de salud"""
    return {
        "status": "ok",
        "service": "NOIACORE CV Generator API",
        "version": "1.0.0"
    }

@app.post("/api/generate", response_model=GenerateResponse)
async def generate_content(request: GenerateRequest):
    """
    Genera contenido para una sección específica del CV usando IA
    """
    try:
        logger.info(f"Generando contenido para sección: {request.section}")
        
        # Generar contenido según la sección
        if request.section == "profile":
            content = await ai_generator.generate_profile(
                request.cv_data,
                request.language
            )
        elif request.section == "experience":
            content = await ai_generator.generate_experience_description(
                request.cv_data.experiences[-1] if request.cv_data.experiences else None,
                request.language
            )
        elif request.section == "skills":
            content = await ai_generator.generate_skills(
                request.cv_data,
                request.language
            )
        elif request.section == "responsibilities":
            content = await ai_generator.generate_responsibilities(
                request.cv_data.experiences[-1] if request.cv_data.experiences else None,
                request.language
            )
        else:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=400,
                detail=f"Sección no soportada: {request.section}"
            )
        
        return GenerateResponse(
            success=True,
            content=content,
            tokens_used=None
        )
        
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"Error generando contenido: {str(e)}")
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=500,
            detail=f"Error generando contenido: {str(e)}"
        )

@app.post("/api/improve")
async def improve_text(request: dict):
    """
    Mejora un texto existente usando IA
    """
    try:
        text = request.get("text", "")
        context = request.get("context", "CV profesional")
        language = request.get("language", "es")
        
        improved = await ai_generator.improve_text(text, context, language)
        
        return {
            "success": True,
            "original": text,
            "improved": improved
        }
        
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"Error mejorando texto: {str(e)}")
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(e))

@app.get("/api/models")
async def list_models():
    """
    Lista los modelos de IA disponibles
    """
    return {
        "available_models": ai_generator.get_available_models(),
        "current_provider": ai_generator.provider,
        "current_model": ai_generator.model
    }

if __name__ == "__main__":
    import uvicorn
    uvicorn.run(
        "main:app",
        host="0.0.0.0",
        port=8000,
        reload=True
    )

### `backend/ai_service.py`

```python
"""
Servicio de IA para generación de contenido
Soporta múltiples proveedores: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Ollama
"""

import os
from typing import Optional, List, Dict
import json
from abc import ABC, abstractmethod

class AIProvider(ABC):
    """Clase base para proveedores de IA"""
    
    @abstractmethod
    async def generate(self, prompt: str, max_tokens: int = 500) -> str:
        pass

class OpenAIProvider(AIProvider):
    """Proveedor OpenAI (GPT-4o, GPT-4o-mini)"""
    
    def __init__(self, api_key: str, model: str = "gpt-4o-mini"):
        self.api_key = api_key
        self.model = model
        
        try:
            from openai import OpenAI
            self.client = OpenAI(api_key=api_key)
        except ImportError:
            raise ImportError("Instala openai: pip install openai")
    
    async def generate(self, prompt: str, max_tokens: int = 500) -> str:
        response = self.client.chat.completions.create(
            model=self.model,
            messages=[
                {"role": "system", "content": "Eres un experto en redacción de CVs profesionales en español. Genera contenido claro, conciso y orientado a resultados."},
                {"role": "user", "content": prompt}
            ],
            max_tokens=max_tokens,
            temperature=0.7
        )
        return response.choices[0].message.content.strip()

class AnthropicProvider(AIProvider):
    """Proveedor Anthropic (Claude)"""
    
    def __init__(self, api_key: str, model: str = "claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022"):
        self.api_key = api_key
        self.model = model
        
        try:
            import anthropic
            self.client = anthropic.Anthropic(api_key=api_key)
        except ImportError:
            raise ImportError("Instala anthropic: pip install anthropic")
    
    async def generate(self, prompt: str, max_tokens: int = 500) -> str:
        message = self.client.messages.create(
            model=self.model,
            max_tokens=max_tokens,
            messages=[
                {
                    "role": "user",
                    "content": f"Eres un experto en redacción de CVs profesionales en español.\n\n{prompt}"
                }
            ]
        )
        return message.content[0].text.strip()

class GeminiProvider(AIProvider):
    """Proveedor Google Gemini"""
    
    def __init__(self, api_key: str, model: str = "gemini-1.5-flash"):
        self.api_key = api_key
        self.model = model
        
        try:
            import google.generativeai as genai
            genai.configure(api_key=api_key)
            self.model_obj = genai.GenerativeModel(model)
        except ImportError:
            raise ImportError("Instala google-generativeai: pip install google-generativeai")
    
    async def generate(self, prompt: str, max_tokens: int = 500) -> str:
        response = self.model_obj.generate_content(
            f"Eres un experto en redacción de CVs profesionales en español.\n\n{prompt}",
            generation_config={"max_output_tokens": max_tokens}
        )
        return response.text.strip()

class OllamaProvider(AIProvider):
    """Proveedor Ollama (modelos locales - sin API key necesaria)"""
    
    def __init__(self, base_url: str = "http://localhost:11434", model: str = "llama3.1"):
        self.base_url = base_url
        self.model = model
        
        try:
            import httpx
            self.client = httpx.AsyncClient()
        except ImportError:
            raise ImportError("Instala httpx: pip install httpx")
    
    async def generate(self, prompt: str, max_tokens: int = 500) -> str:
        response = await self.client.post(
            f"{self.base_url}/api/generate",
            json={
                "model": self.model,
                "prompt": f"Eres un experto en redacción de CVs profesionales en español.\n\n{prompt}",
                "stream": False,
                "options": {
                    "num_predict": max_tokens
                }
            }
        )
        response.raise_for_status()
        return response.json()["response"].strip()

class AIGenerator:
    """Generador principal de contenido con IA"""
    
    def __init__(
        self,
        provider: str = "openai",
        api_key: Optional[str] = None,
        model: str = "gpt-4o-mini",
        base_url: Optional[str] = None
    ):
        self.provider = provider
        self.model = model
        
        # Inicializar proveedor según configuración
        if provider == "openai":
            if not api_key:
                raise ValueError("OpenAI requiere API key")
            self.ai_provider = OpenAIProvider(api_key, model)
            
        elif provider == "anthropic":
            if not api_key:
                raise ValueError("Anthropic requiere API key")
            self.ai_provider = AnthropicProvider(api_key, model)
            
        elif provider == "gemini":
            if not api_key:
                raise ValueError("Gemini requiere API key")
            self.ai_provider = GeminiProvider(api_key, model)
            
        elif provider == "ollama":
            base_url = base_url or "http://localhost:11434"
            self.ai_provider = OllamaProvider(base_url, model)
            
        else:
            raise ValueError(f"Proveedor no soportado: {provider}")
    
    async def generate_profile(self, cv_data, language: str = "es") -> str:
        """Genera perfil profesional basado en experiencia y habilidades"""
        
        # Extraer información relevante
        experiences = cv_data.experiences if cv_data.experiences else []
        skills = cv_data.skills if cv_data.skills else []
        title = cv_data.personal.title if cv_data.personal else ""
        
        # Construir prompt
        exp_summary = "\n".join([
            f"- {exp.position} en {exp.company} ({exp.start_date} - {exp.end_date})"
            for exp in experiences
        ]) if experiences else "Sin experiencia laboral registrada"
        
        skills_list = ", ".join(skills) if skills else "Sin habilidades registradas"
        
        prompt = f"""Genera un perfil profesional de máximo 3-4 líneas para un CV.

INFORMACIÓN DEL CANDIDATO:
- Título profesional: {title or 'No especificado'}
- Experiencia laboral:
{exp_summary}
- Habilidades principales: {skills_list}

REQUISITOS:
- Escribe en español profesional
- Máximo 500 caracteres
- Destaca años de experiencia, especialización y soft skills
- Usa verbos de acción y lenguaje orientado a resultados
- NO uses primera persona (evita "Soy", "Tengo")
- Enfócate en valor aportado al empleador

EJEMPLO DE ESTILO:
"Profesional con 5+ años de experiencia en [sector]. Especializado en [área]. Destaca por [soft skills]. Orientado a [objetivo profesional]."

Genera el perfil:"""
        
        return await self.ai_provider.generate(prompt, max_tokens=200)
    
    async def generate_experience_description(
        self,
        experience,
        language: str = "es"
    ) -> str:
        """Genera descripción mejorada de experiencia laboral"""
        
        if not experience:
            return ""
        
        prompt = f"""Mejora la descripción de esta experiencia laboral para un CV profesional.

INFORMACIÓN ACTUAL:
- Puesto: {experience.position}
- Empresa: {experience.company}
- Período: {experience.start_date} - {experience.end_date}
- Descripción actual: {experience.description or 'Sin descripción'}

REQUISITOS:
- Escribe en español profesional
- 2-3 líneas máximo
- Usa verbos de acción fuertes (gestioné, implementé, lideré, optimicé)
- Cuantifica logros cuando sea posible (%, números, resultados)
- Enfócate en impacto y responsabilidades clave
- NO uses primera persona

EJEMPLO DE ESTILO:
"Gestión integral de [responsabilidad principal]. Implementación de [mejora/proceso] que resultó en [resultado cuantificable]. Liderazgo de [equipo/proyecto] con [logro específico]."

Genera la descripción mejorada:"""
        
        return await self.ai_provider.generate(prompt, max_tokens=300)
    
    async def generate_responsibilities(
        self,
        experience,
        language: str = "es"
    ) -> List[str]:
        """Genera lista de responsabilidades para un puesto"""
        
        if not experience:
            return []
        
        prompt = f"""Genera 5-7 responsabilidades profesionales para este puesto de trabajo.

PUESTO: {experience.position}
EMPRESA: {experience.company}
SECTOR: Inferir del puesto

REQUISITOS:
- Escribe en español profesional
- Cada responsabilidad en una línea separada
- Usa verbos de acción al inicio de cada punto
- Sé específico y orientado a resultados
- NO uses primera persona
- Máximo 15 palabras por responsabilidad

FORMATO DE SALIDA (una responsabilidad por línea):
Responsabilidad 1
Responsabilidad 2
Responsabilidad 3
...

Genera las responsabilidades:"""
        
        response = await self.ai_provider.generate(prompt, max_tokens=400)
        
        # Procesar respuesta: dividir por líneas y limpiar
        responsibilities = [
            line.strip() for line in response.split('\n')
            if line.strip() and not line.strip().startswith('#')
        ][:7]  # Máximo 7 responsabilidades
        
        return responsibilities
    
    async def generate_skills(self, cv_data, language: str = "es") -> List[str]:
        """Genera habilidades relevantes basadas en experiencia"""
        
        experiences = cv_data.experiences if cv_data.experiences else []
        title = cv_data.personal.title if cv_data.personal else ""
        
        exp_positions = "\n".join([exp.position for exp in experiences]) if experiences else "No especificado"
        
        prompt = f"""Genera 10-15 habilidades profesionales relevantes para este perfil.

TÍTULO PROFESIONAL: {title or 'No especificado'}
PUESTOS DESEMPENADOS:
{exp_positions}

REQUISITOS:
- Escribe en español
- Incluye mezcla de:
  * Habilidades técnicas (hard skills): 60%
  * Habilidades blandas (soft skills): 40%
- Cada habilidad en una línea separada
- Máximo 4 palabras por habilidad
- Ordena de más a menos relevante

FORMATO DE SALIDA (una habilidad por línea):
Habilidad 1
Habilidad 2
...

Genera las habilidades:"""
        
        response = await self.ai_provider.generate(prompt, max_tokens=300)
        
        skills = [
            line.strip() for line in response.split('\n')
            if line.strip() and not line.strip().startswith('#')
        ][:15]
        
        return skills
    
    async def improve_text(
        self,

    ) -> str:
        """Mejora un texto existente"""
        
        prompt = f"""Mejora este texto para un {context}.

{text}

Versión mejorada:"""

/**
 * Cliente de IA para Generador de CV
 * Maneja comunicación con backend y generación de contenido
 */

class AIGenerator {
  constructor(apiBaseUrl = 'http://localhost:8000') {
    this.apiBaseUrl = apiBaseUrl;
    this.loadingElement = null;
    this.isGenerating = false;
  }

  /**
   * Genera contenido para una sección específica del CV
   * @param {string} section - Sección a generar (profile, experience, skills, etc.)
   * @param {Object} cvData - Datos actuales del CV
   * @param {string} language - Idioma del contenido
   * @returns {Promise<string>} - Contenido generado
   */
  async generateContent(section, cvData, language = 'es') {
    if (this.isGenerating) {
      console.warn('Ya hay una generación en progreso');
      return null;
    }

    this.isGenerating = true;
    this.showLoading(true);

    try {
      const response = await fetch(`${this.apiBaseUrl}/api/generate`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          section: section,
          cv_data: cvData,
          language: language
        })
      });

      if (!response.ok) {
        const errorData = await response.json();
        throw new Error(errorData.detail || 'Error generando contenido');
      }

      const data = await response.json();
      
      if (!data.success) {
        throw new Error(data.error || 'Error desconocido');
      }

      return data.content;

    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error en generación de IA:', error);
      this.showError(error.message);
      throw error;
    } finally {
      this.isGenerating = false;
      this.showLoading(false);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Genera perfil profesional
   */
  async generateProfile(cvData) {
    return await this.generateContent('profile', cvData);
  }

  /**
   * Genera descripción de experiencia laboral
   */
  async generateExperienceDescription(cvData) {
    return await this.generateContent('experience', cvData);
  }

  /**
   * Genera lista de responsabilidades
   */
  async generateResponsibilities(cvData) {
    const responsibilities = await this.generateContent('responsibilities', cvData);
    
    // Si viene como string, convertir a array
    if (typeof responsibilities === 'string') {
      return responsibilities.split('\n').filter(line => line.trim());
    }
    
    return responsibilities;
  }

  /**
   * Genera habilidades profesionales
   */
  async generateSkills(cvData) {
    const skills = await this.generateContent('skills', cvData);
    
    if (typeof skills === 'string') {
      return skills.split('\n').filter(line => line.trim());
    }
    
    return skills;
  }

  /**
   * Mejora un texto existente
   */
  async improveText(text, context = 'CV profesional') {
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`${this.apiBaseUrl}/api/improve`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          text: text,
          context: context,
          language: 'es'
        })
      });

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error('Error mejorando texto');
      }

      const data = await response.json();
      return data.improved;

    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error mejorando texto:', error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Verifica disponibilidad del backend
   */
  async checkHealth() {
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`${this.apiBaseUrl}/`);
      return response.ok;
    } catch (error) {
      return false;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Obtiene modelos disponibles
   */
  async getAvailableModels() {
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`${this.apiBaseUrl}/api/models`);
      const data = await response.json();
      return data;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error obteniendo modelos:', error);
      return null;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Muestra indicador de carga
   */
  showLoading(show) {
    if (!this.loadingElement) {
      this.loadingElement = document.getElementById('ai-loading');
    }

    if (this.loadingElement) {
      this.loadingElement.style.display = show ? 'flex' : 'none';
    }

    // Deshabilitar botones de generación
    const generateButtons = document.querySelectorAll('[data-generate-section]');
    generateButtons.forEach(btn => {
      btn.disabled = show;
      btn.style.opacity = show ? '0.5' : '1';
    });
  }

  /**
   * Muestra mensaje de error
   */
  showError(message) {
    // Crear notificación de error
    const errorDiv = document.createElement('div');
    errorDiv.className = 'ai-error-notification';
    errorDiv.innerHTML = `
      <div class="error-content">
        <span class="error-icon">⚠️</span>
        <span class="error-message">${message}</span>
        <button class="error-close" onclick="this.parentElement.parentElement.remove()">×</button>
      </div>
    `;

    document.body.appendChild(errorDiv);

    // Auto-eliminar después de 5 segundos
    setTimeout(() => {
      errorDiv.remove();
    }, 5000);
  }
}
